nodes.title: Repair E2E TIA regressions on main

description:
Restore the Orbit main branch after ORB-238 exposed two E2E TIA contract regressions at `f9ae1b841412661df409a64b2e9db37da9db230c`.

## Scope

* In: classify the new PHPUnit guidance and scenario configuration files as non-runtime static-proof inputs.
* In: keep the corrupt-guidance regression proving that the configured fresh TIA command runs and fails, without depending on an optional Pest console heading.
* Out: Gateway product behavior, Doctor families, proof topology behavior, schema changes, and documentation changes.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `phpunit.guidance.xml`, `phpunit.scenario-cold.xml`, and `phpunit.scenario-snapshot.xml` are explicitly classified as non-runtime proof inputs, and every tracked repository path has a determinate classification.
- [ ] The corrupt-guidance regression proves the configured command contains `--tia --fresh`, fails on the corrupted contract, and never emits the partial-run warning; it does not require Pest to render a TIA heading in captured subprocess output.
- [ ] `cd apps/e2e && composer test` passes and confirms TIA mode.
- [ ] The E2E project checks and the exact-candidate root Builder gate pass with TIA-only Pest commands.
- [ ] Documentation remains unchanged because this only restores existing test and proof-input contracts.

## Verification

Run only TIA-enabled Pest commands. Do not pass Pest paths, filters, groups, suites, or `--no-tia`.
